services.desc: Create a Website Account - Manage notification subscriptions, save form progress and more. To participate in this program, please purchase a 2026 season pass, fill out a 2026 lap swimming waiver, and return to City Hall. Note that each family member participating in this program needs to turn in a signed lap swimming waiver. All swimmers must be at least 18 years of age in order to participate. If you experience any issues with your access card, please be aware that police dispatch (24/7) and the front desk at City Hall (business hours) have cards they can lend to you. ProgramsTwo camps run side by side in the clubhouse during June and July: a Preschool Camp for ages 3-6 and the “Big Room” Camp for older children. Parents can place their 6-7 year old children in the Big Room and request a little extra attention to ensure a smooth transition from the Little Room.
